content.title: Fans wonder why Oscar winner Sean Penn wasn’t at Academy Awards
content.text: NewsPublished: Mar. 15, 2026, 8:44 p.m.Sean Penn, who won Best Supporting Actor at the Oscars for “One Battle After Another,” was not at the award show, making his win one of the night’s biggest surprises. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello)Chris Pizzello/Invision/APLOS ANGELES — Actor Sean Penn was not at the 98th Academy Awards on Sunday even though he won one of the night’s top acting prizes. The Oscars took place in Los Angeles, but Penn was not on the red carpet or in the crowd when his name was called. Penn earned the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his role in “One Battle After Another,” a film directed by Paul Thomas Anderson. This marks his third time winning an Oscar, joining some of the most famous actors in history with three wins. Before the Oscars, Penn had already missed two other major awards shows where he was expected to be honored. He was not at the BAFTA Awards or the Actor Awards, even though he won at both events. Inside the Oscars theater, presenter Kieran Culkin accepted Penn’s trophy for him. Because Penn was not there, he did not give a speech in front of the audience. People who watch film events had guessed Penn might not attend. Sites that track who will go to the Oscars showed Penn near the bottom of the list of likely arrivals. Some people online said his attendance odds were low because he often skips big shows. Penn has a history of avoiding awards ceremonies. In past years, he has said he does not enjoy being part of the big Hollywood parties and formal award shows, even when he is nominated for big prizes. He has spoken about choosing projects that matter to him and has focused more on directing and other film work instead of attending shows. Many of Penn’s fans said they expected he might skip the Oscars again this year because of his past attendance choices. His win for “One Battle After Another” was a big moment, but many news outlets and fans still talked about his absence. Some said it was unusual to win such a high honor without being present, while others said that Penn has made similar choices before. Penn has been a major figure in Hollywood for decades. He has won Oscars before, including Best Actor for “Mystic River” and “Milk.” Many people remember his past awards even when he chooses not to attend ceremonies.
